VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the self-report claims all 58 tests pass and describes the fix, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires "all 58 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof, not assertion. Self-reports are the weakest evidence class and cannot establish objective test results without supporting documentation.
